2026-10-28-cyberforum-akademie-intro-age.title: Generative AI at work
2026-10-28-cyberforum-akademie-intro-age.description: How does generative AI work, and how can it genuinely help at work? This interactive introduction gives you a mental model of how AI behaves, whatever the tool: big tasks split into steps, the AI works through them, and you stay captain in between. Prompting basics and meta-prompting come not as theory but as copy-ready prompts, and in the live demo "Grill me" the AI helps you find the right question first. To go deeper: the hands-on workshop on 16 November 2026 turns to concrete use cases.
